descriptionByLocale.en:
To complete our maternity team (approx. 1500 births per year), we are looking for 1 December 2026 or a date to agree on:

Your main tasks:
• · Accompanied patients during childbirth and during prenatal and postnatal periods.
• · Provide patients with quality care while respecting their safety and comfort.
• · Provide information on the health status of mothers and babies.
• · Practice neonatal surveillance in isolation.
• · Advise perinatal parents.

Your profile:
• · Holder of a midwife bachelor's degree or equivalent degree recognized in Switzerland (CRS).
• · Experience of a few years in necessary delivery rooms.
• · Feeling welcome and ease in contacts.
• · Good knowledge of German and English, a real asset.
• · Ability to work as a team in a respectful and rigorous manner.
• We offer you :
• · A varied and motivating work in a multidisciplinary hospital.
• · Benefits of a human-sized facility.
• · The possibility of evolving in a dynamic environment.

Mrs. Françoise Troesch (tel. 026 429 94 85) or Mrs. Martine Conus (tel. 026 429 93 52), maternity officers are at your disposal for further information.

We look forward to receiving your complete application package through our recruitment platform.
